conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration risk, aiming for lower drawdowns. Expect slower growth due to reduced risk exposure.

plan: Trim broad index holdings (SPY, QQQ) to reduce concentration.

balanced.read: This balanced approach targets about 2.5% monthly return by focusing on risk reduction while still seeking growth. It trims concentrated positions and adds new, high-potential names. Leverage is managed to keep risk in check.

plan: Trim broad index (SPY) to manage concentration.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for high growth (~4% monthly) by increasing leverage and concentrating in top-rated setups. It accepts higher risk, including amplified drawdowns and the daily decay of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

income.read: This income-focused plan aims for a steady ~1% monthly return through distributions, prioritizing capital preservation. It cuts volatile assets and shifts towards income-generating ETFs. While designed for low drawdowns, NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
